newsitem.title: CANADA: Northstar Energy sees higher Q1 oil output.
newsitem.headline: Northstar Energy sees higher Q1 oil output.

text.p: Northstar Energy Corp said on Monday it expected its oil production to top 14,000 barrels a day by the end of the first quarter, up from an average of 12,000 in 1996.
Northstar, which earlier reported higher earnings and cash flow for the year, also said it planned to increase its exploitation activities for natural gas because of current strong prices.
The company's gas production averaged 125 million cubic feet a day in 1996, up from 122 million the year before.
Its average price for gas was C$1.49 per thousand cubic feet in 1996, up from C$1.39 in 1995.
Northstar's average oil price last year was C$23.06 a barrel, up from C$19.30 per barrel, it said.
Northstar said total spending fell 33 percent last year to C$116.7 million.
At the end of 1996, proved and prabable reserves totaled 336 billion cubic feet of gas and 36 million barrels of oil and gas liquids.
Reserves were replaced by a factor of 2.2 times in 1996, Northstar said.
